```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)
library(pins)
library(gt)

# Load helper functions
source("R/hubspot-helpers.R")

# Set up token
hubspot_token <- Sys.getenv("HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN")
if (hubspot_token == "") {
  stop(
    "HubSpot access token not found. Please set HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable."
  )
}
```

## ETL Process for HubSpot Deals

### Get the stages for deals and all deals with creation time
```{r get-specific-deal}
# Get custom stage labels
stages <- get_stages()

# Get all deals with creation time
all_deals <- get_all_deals_with_creation()

# Show summary
cat("Total deals:", nrow(all_deals), "\n")
cat(
  "Date range:",
  paste0(range(all_deals$created_date), collapse = ' to '),
  "\n"
)
```

### Get deal histories and join with deal info
```{r deal-history}
load_from_disk <- TRUE
if (
  load_from_disk &
    file.exists("deal_history.rds") &
    file.exists("deals.rds")
) {
  deal_history <- readRDS("deal_history.rds")
  deals <- readRDS("deals.rds")
} else {
  deal_history <- get_deal_history(all_deals$deal_id)
  deal_history_count <- deal_history |>
    count(deal_id, name = "n_history")

  # Join with deal info
  deals <- all_deals |>
    left_join(deal_history_count, by = "deal_id") |>
    left_join(stages, by = c("stage" = "stage_id"))
}

```

### Pin the data for future use
```{r pin-deals}
board <- board_connect()
board |>
  pin_write(
    deals,
    "deals",
    type = "csv",
    description = "All deals with history count"
  )
board |>
  pin_write(
    deal_history,
    "deal_history",
    type = "csv",
    description = "Deal history records"
  )

```

## Some deals don't have history
```{r}
deals |> 
  mutate(has_history = ! is.na(n_history)) |>
  count(has_history) |>
  gt()
```


## Deals Lookup
```{r}
deals |>
  select(-stage, -pipeline) |>
  reactable(
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      deal_id = colDef(name = "Deal ID"),
      deal_name = colDef(name = "Deal Name"),
      amount = colDef(name = "Amount", format = colFormat(currency = "USD")),
      stage_label = colDef(name = "Stage"),
      created_date = colDef(name = "Created"),
      modified_date = colDef(name = "Modified"),
      close_date = colDef(name = "Close Date"),
      n_history = colDef(name = "History Count")
    )
  )
```

## Deal History Lookup

```{r}
#default the DealID to the first deal with history
default_deal_id <- deals |> filter(n_history > 0) |> slice(1) |> pull(deal_id)

deal_history |>
  reactable(
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    columns = list(
      deal_id = colDef(
        name = "Deal ID",
        searchable = TRUE,
        filterable = TRUE,
      ),
      ts = colDef(name = "Timestamp"),
      amount = colDef(name = "Amount", format = colFormat(currency = "USD")),
      stage_id = colDef(name = "Stage ID"),
      stage_label = colDef(name = "Stage"),
      user_name = colDef(name = "User")
    )
  )
```
